references.label: Royal Flush drops
references.description: In Alien Poker, each K-I-N-G completion raises the Royal Flush multiplier, and three sets produce the 4x maximum. Use lane change to finish the top lanes, then hit the five center drops from right to left in the order 10, J, Q, K, A. Avoid later cards until their turn because an out-of-order hit raises the target and lowers the collect; finish the ordered set for 400,000 and repeat.
